# Transactions: Delete a Transaction

Area overview and notes: [transactions.md](../transactions.md)

`DELETE /transactions/external-id/{id}` · tenant-scoped token

Delete a transaction using your system's unique identifier.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Your system's unique identifier for the Transaction. |

**Response 200**: Delete transaction response.

Same fields as the response of [Send a Transaction to Taxbit](send-a-transaction-to-taxbit.md).

**Errors:** 401 Unauthorized · 404 Not Found · 429 Too Many Requests
